title: Mixtape and Semester
author: Yara Delacroix
blurb: Edmund Eastwick, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
